title: Desert Gold
author: Zane Grey
description: "Desert Gold" by Zane Grey is a novel written in the early 20th century.
longDescription: It explores themes of love, remorse, and survival against the backdrop of the harsh desert landscape, following a cast of characters intertwined by their pasts. The central figures include Cameron, a prospector haunted by memories of a lost love, and Warren, an older prospector who shares a deep-seated connection to Cameron through a tragic past involving a woman named Nell.

authorInfo.bio: Zane Grey was an American author. He is known for his popular adventure novels and stories associated with the Western genre in literature and the arts; he idealized the American frontier. Riders of the Purple Sage (1912) was his best-selling book.
